messages:
Maria: Heads-up — kickoff for a small admin entitlement sweep this week. Goal: remove stale cloud-admins, validate KMS grants, and surface anything blocking scheduled jobs. Aim to finish by Fri EOD. Volunteers?
Alex: I'll take the lead on IAM bindings + canary runs.
Maya: Quick Q — do we have 6mo audit logs for admin ops? I think staging CloudTrail is only 90d.
audit-bot: prod CloudTrail logs: retention=365d, staging=90d. KMS audit logs (prod): exported to log-archive, retention=730d. See https://logs.example.com/archives/123 :eyes:
Sam: For any user->svcacct removals we should pre-check token usage. Run `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail' --limit=1000` or `aws logs filter-log-events` to find recent activity.
Jen: Also note: vuln triage flagged KMS agent CVE-2026-0423 (low exploitability). We should rotate admin keys for affected clusters as precaution. Who owns KMS rotation?
Alex: Platform team owns KMS. Pinging @platform-oncall — can you confirm rotation windows and whether rotation will break anything?
platform-oncall: Saw the ping — we'll schedule a rotation canary in staging tomorrow 09:00 PT. No known immediate breakages but will monitor jobs for missing grants. We'll post the canary results in this thread.
Maria: Thanks. Action items: (1) Alex + Sam — IAM binding list + identify stale admins (2) Jen + Platform — KMS rotation plan + canary (3) Maya — confirm audit evidence for owners. Target: canary complete by Thu 12:00 PT, full sweep by Fri EOD.
Sam: I'll run a quick script to surface admins with no activity in last 120 days and drop into a spreadsheet.
Jen: I'll open a vuln incident with mitigation steps and link it to the rotation. Adding checklist to runbook: rotate, validate grants, notify app owners.
Maria: Perfect. Please add results to the runbook page and ping infra-oncall if the canary shows missing grants. :thumbsup:
Alex: On it, will share initial admin list in ~2h.
Sam: ack
Maya: ack — I'll collate logs and owners by EOD
platform-oncall: Can confirm staging canary scheduled. Will post status update 09:45 PT tomorrow.
Maria: Great — thanks team. If anything urgent, escalate to sec-pager. Closing initial thread when canary passes.
